scenarios.name: Dismiss menus and return to drawing
scenarios.reason:
You asked to open the main menu and then close it by clicking an empty area of the drawing canvas.
The main menu in the upper-left was opened, and its menu items appeared.
An empty area of the drawing canvas was clicked, closing the menu and hiding its items.

steps.remark: click: Clicking the main menu button in the upper left
analyze: the main menu's menu items are visible
assert: its menu items are visible
click: Clicking empty drawing canvas away from the menu
analyze: the main menu is closed
assert: the menu items are no longer visible and the main menu is closed

fix.summary: The main menu skipped outside-click registration while its content was unmounted. It now registers the listener on the content’s owner document when the content mounts, so clicking the canvas dismisses the menu.

attempts.summary: The main menu skipped outside-click registration while its content was unmounted. It now registers the listener on the content’s owner document when the content mounts, so clicking the canvas dismisses the menu.
